tz-5uTb.title: Landscape: high altitude, dark rock, snow
tz-5uTb.summary: The mountain tripods show dark grey rock, snow far away, and sometimes climbers and tents.

tz-B3Lv.title: Landscape: open forest, savannah trees
tz-B3Lv.summary: Higher up the hills, the forest opens up and you see savannah-like trees.

tz-JhL0.title: Coverage: mountain tripods, dreamy look
tz-JhL0.summary: Tripods on the big mountain use a normal camera on a stand, so images look ethereal: motion blur and slightly saturated colours. Other countries have tripods too.

tz-VyY8.title: Coverage: very limited, off-road only
tz-VyY8.summary: Only a few Gen 3 trekkers and tripods in a national park and on a mountain, plus a few spill-over car shots at the border. None are on roads, so just memorise what they look like.

tz-byuh.title: Landscape: bare grass hilltops, lake views
tz-byuh.summary: On top of the hills the trees give way to bare grassland, with wide views of a big lake.

tz-eCS1.title: Coverage: tripod inside a famous house
tz-eCS1.summary: One more tripod is inside the house of a famous primatologist, next to the Gen 3 trekker coverage in the same national park.

tz-zbUq.title: Coverage: boat trekker, olive green boat
tz-zbUq.summary: A boat trekker hugs the shore of a big lake, with the coast always to the east. The boat is olive green and white and always pixelated through the blur. Do not confuse it with Madagascar's boats.

differs.how: Madagascar has boat coverage too, but it is a different boat

tz-zdnx.title: Coverage: dark jungle trekker, chimps
tz-zdnx.summary: A walking trekker covers much of a national park. In lowlands there is dense jungle and little light, so images are dark. You may see chimpanzees.
